KKR Charged by EU Over Telecom Italia Deal Misleading Regulators

KKR has been charged by the European Union's competition regulators for allegedly misleading them over the private equity firm's acquisition of Telecom Italia's network assets. The deal, valued at €22 billion, is under scrutiny by the European Commission. The specific allegations involve KKR providing inaccurate or incomplete information during the regulatory review process.
